entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel and divine protector of Innistrad, created by Sorin Markov, corrupted and then unmade.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Avacyn's creator, a planeswalker who destroyed her. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane Avacyn protected.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker whose cryptoliths contributed to the mental invasion of Avacyn. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi titan whose latent influence corrupted Avacyn.

entities.name: Cursemute
entities.description: The magic Avacyn used to bring peace.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The artifact whose sundering preceded Avacyn's return.

entities.name: Kelse
entities.description: A villager who prayed to Avacyn for help finding her son.

entities.name: Maeli
entities.description: Kelse's missing son.

entities.name: Macher
entities.description: A Lunarch mocked by Avacyn.

entities.name: Liont
entities.description: A werewolf destroyed by Avacyn.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Threatened by Avacyn to join her campaign.

entities.name: Bruna
entities.description: A fallen angel who accompanied Avacyn.

entities.name: Gisela
entities.description: A fallen angel who accompanied Avacyn.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who tried to restrain Avacyn. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker who tried to restrain Avacyn. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: Site of the confrontation with Avacyn.

entities.name: Vault of the Archangel
entities.description: Where Sorin imprisoned Avacyn.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The faith shattered by her death.

entities.name: Travails
entities.description: The period of violence that began with Avacyn's mental infection.

entities.name: Unmaking of Avacyn
entities.description: The tragic downfall and destruction of Avacyn.

events.summary: Avacyn rescues Maeli but is attacked by a spell that invades her mind with thoughts of mankind's corruption, beginning the Travails.
Avacyn mocks Lunarch Macher and brutally destroys the werewolf Liont.
events.quote: When the werewolf Liont prayed to her after killing his family, she brutally destroyed him.

events.summary: Avacyn threatens Sigarda and leads an angelic assault on Kelse's village.
events.quote: She then led a devastating angelic assault on Kelse’s village

events.summary: Jace and Tamiyo fail to restrain Avacyn at Thraben Cathedral; Sorin arrives and confronts her.
events.quote: planeswalkers Jace Beleren and Tamiyo attempted to restrain Avacyn but failed.

events.summary: Sorin defeats Avacyn and imprisons her in the Vault of the Archangel.
events.quote: Their ensuing battle ended with Sorin defeating Avacyn and imprisoning her in the Vault of the Archangel .

events.summary: Avacyn refuses healing and Sorin unravels the spell that created her, ending her existence.
events.quote: Sorin then unraveled the spell that created her, effectively ending her existence.

events.summary: Avacyn's death shatters the Church of Avacyn.
events.quote: leaving the faithful leaderless and causing widespread crises of faith

relations.quote: Sorin Markov , Avacyn’s creator, arrived and confronted her.

relations.note: Unraveled the spell that created her.
relations.quote: Sorin then unraveled the spell that created her, effectively ending her existence.

relations.note: Her death left the faithful leaderless.
